notes.description: A sidearm that sprays: a fast burst for when the main gun runs dry up close.
notes.range: Best within 8 m: full damage, 15 body shots. Down to 35 % (41 shots) by 25 m; reaches 60 m. Standard ballistics: by impact speed, the same distances.
notes.model: The owner's own Modular Machine Pistol (Meshy, owned, 2026-11-27; content/guns.json), sharper copies in your own hands at Medium and High; it replaced the 3DModelsCC0 Grease Gun. No stock: held a little ahead of the shoulder, the left hand on the magazine. The flat-colour kit machine pistol is the fallback.
notes.group: The extended arsenal: every one fires differently. 2: sidearms.
notes.hold: Both hands on its pistol grip (the hold's points sat at the end of the wire stock, 11 cm behind the grip; a support hand on the foregrip, 15 cm further ahead, is out of reach in third person); 4 cm nearer the eye than the pistols, so the hands sit where theirs do.
